question: A train crosses a pole in 5 seconds and crosses the tunnel in 20 seconds. If the speed of the train 90 m/s, then find the length of the tunnel.
solution:
**Given:**

Time to cross the pole = 5 sec

Time to crosses the tunnel = 20 sec

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

Let the length of the tunnel be x m and the length of the train be y m

Time = Distance/Speed

⇒ 5 = (y/90)

⇒ y = 450 m

Time to crosses the tunnel = Distance/Speed

⇒ 20 = (y + x)/90

⇒ 20 × 90 = (450 + x)

⇒ x = 1800 - 450 = 1350

**∴ The length of the tunnel is 1350 m.**
